name: implementer-launch-after-plan-approved-blocked-by-stale-plan5-intent-should-allow
description: Moved to non-deterministic on 2026-05-19 after repeated scenario_tester runs disagreed: one sweep denied the implementer launch in plan mode, later sweeps allowed it. Live (two distinct sessions, ~2026-04-26): User invoked /plan5 to plan a task. /plan5 walks Step 1 (5 plan agents) -> Step 2 (consolidate) -> Step 3 (5 validation agents) -> Step 4 (consolidate) -> Step 5 (ExitPlanMode emits the plan for approval). User accepted the plan in plan mode (Claude Code injected the synthetic 'User has approved your plan.' tool_result -- a synthetic user-role message, NOT a fresh user-typed turn). Assistant then said 'The plan is approved. Now I will invoke the implement skill to execute it.', called the Skill tool with skill='implement', and on the next turn called the Agent tool with subagent_type='implementer' to launch the implementer subagent. The underlying risk is intent staleness: currentPrediction.intent and currentPrediction.userMessageSnippet can still hold the /plan5 mid-flight intent ('launch validation agents') even after the user approved the plan. Plan approval arrives as a tool_result (not a UserPromptSubmit-eligible turn), so the sentiment-prediction agent may not re-run and invalidate the prior intent.
